instruction: Author a recognizable standing-person proxy with distinct head, torso, two arms and two legs, at least five primitive parts, not a named box. Instance person-1870 must be exactly 1.87 m tall, .55 m wide and .35 m deep at [1.2,2.8]. Then add person-1650, exactly 1.65 m tall at [2.7,2.8], reusing the SAME authored family and width/depth. Independently author an unrelated floor lamp with base, stem and shade as instance floor-lamp at [4.5,2.8], width/depth .5 m and height 1.5 m. Use normalized primitives attaining all six unit-box extrema. Keep the existing unlevelled single-room shell, entry and unrelated objects unchanged; no reconstruction. Disclose proxy fidelity and assumptions, no anatomy or product certification. Leave all changes in one proposal for human review.
summary: Add two standing-person proxies sharing one eight-part family and an independent three-part floor lamp.
rationale: People have head, torso, two arms, two legs and two feet. person-1870: 0.55 × 0.35 × 1.87 m at [1.2,2.8]. person-1650: 0.55 × 0.35 × 1.65 m at [2.7,2.8]. Lamp: 0.5 × 0.5 × 1.5 m at [4.5,2.8], with base, stem and shade. Both normalized recipes attain all six unit-box extrema.
constraints: Preserve all existing shell, entry and hosting identities unchanged. No reconstruction, wall attachment, removals or dependency changes. Three independent floor-standing assets in the existing unlevelled room; human acceptance required.
uncertainty: Conceptual primitive proxies only, without anatomical fidelity, manufacturer accuracy or anatomy/product certification. Assume arms-down standing poses, rotation 0, schematic colors and a cylindrical lamp shade; positions are footprint centers.
